## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
ROTATION — Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: cyclicals lead (Materials, Energy, Industrials posting strong 1W gains and multiple ABOVE TREND names) while large-cap Tech shows mixed/patchy performance, consistent with rotation rather than broad risk-off.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Materials lead: FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.96% | 1M: +22.79%), NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.04% | 1M: +20.33%).  
Energy strong: SLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.91% | 1M: +10.17%), VLO ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.52% | 1M: +5.58%). Industrials showing strength: BA ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.40% | 1M: +12.99%) with CAT in RECOVERY (1W: +3.31% | 1M: -1.10%).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Consumer Staples weak: PG BELOW TREND (1W: -4.17% | 1M: -3.77%), PEP BELOW TREND (1W: -4.96% | 1M: -5.52%). Communication under pressure: META BELOW TREND (1W: -2.59% | 1M: -3.59%). Utilities lag the market on 1W performance and negative sentiment.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.29% | 1M: +2.95%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.40% | 1M: +9.03%), VLO ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.52% | 1M: +5.58%), SLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.91% | 1M: +10.17%), FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.96% | 1M: +22.79%). Leadership: Concentrated (Top 5 split across 3 sectors — Tech, Energy, Materials), signalling sectoral rotation rather than broad market breadth.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: PG BELOW TREND (1W: -4.17% | 1M: -3.77%), PM CORRECTION (1W: -4.20% | 1M: +5.92%), CCI BELOW TREND (1W: -4.50% | 1M: -3.57%), AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -4.67% | 1M: -6.62%), PEP BELOW TREND (1W: -4.96% | 1M: -5.52%). Weakness concentrated in Consumer Staples and select large-cap Tech names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Strongest 1W movers: INTC (1W: +14.29% | 1M: +2.95%), AMAT (1W: +12.40% | 1M: +9.03%), VLO (1W: +11.52% | 1M: +5.58%), SLB (1W: +9.91% | 1M: +10.17%), FCX (1W: +7.96% | 1M: +22.79%). Major divergence flagged: several large names show 1W ≠ 1M (MSFT, CAT, AIG), implying MAJOR divergence — watch for trend break and treat moves as tactical, not yet broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed/rotational: NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.84% | 1M: +3.67%), GOOGL ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.59% | 1M: +0.29%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.40% | 1M: +9.03%) offset by AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -4.67% | 1M: -6.62%) and MSFT in CORRECTION (1W: -0.82% | 1M: +0.06%). Sector showing internal rotation rather than uniform strength.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials constructive: JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.56% | 1M: +4.26%), GS ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.40% | 1M: +10.12%), V ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.64% | 1M: +7.44%) with broad participation across the group; sector supportive of the rotation into cyclicals.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare steady: LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.62% | 1M: +9.68%), UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.87% | 1M: +3.95%), JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.28% | 1M: +2.75%) — defensive names not leading but providing ballast.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor cyclicals and quality Financials and Materials (JPM ABOVE TREND, FCX ABOVE TREND, SLB ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to large-cap Tech names showing weakness (AAPL BELOW TREND, META BELOW TREND). Style: Value/Cyclical favored in this rotation; monitor MAJOR divergences before adding to core positions.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.40% | 1M: +9.03%), SLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.91% | 1M: +10.17%), FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.96% | 1M: +22.79%).  
BEARISH: AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -4.67% | 1M: -6.62%), META BELOW TREND (1W: -2.59% | 1M: -3.59%), AIG CORRECTION (1W: -10.52% | 1M: +0.58%).

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Materials, Energy, Industrials (strong 1W leadership and multiple ABOVE TREND names).  
BEARISH: Consumer Staples, Utilities, Communication (1W declines and negative sentiment concentrated here).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA resistance test near near-term highs—watch for continuation (NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.84% | 1M: +3.67%)). AAPL support area to monitor around recent lows (AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -4.67% | 1M: -6.62%)). JPM trend continuation level to watch on further upside (JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.56% | 1M: +4.26%)).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
AMAT (+55): AI-driven factory spending headline; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.40% | 1M: +9.03%) — sentiment confirmed. SLB (+65): Aramco win and partner deal; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.91% | 1M: +10.17%) — confirming accumulation. GOOGL (+50): upgrade headline; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.59% | 1M: +0.29%) — confirming modest follow-through.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
XOM (-50): lower oil-price warning; XOM in TREND EXHAUSTION (1W: -2.07% | 1M: +1.67%) — sentiment aligns with short-term softness. FCX (-50): cost concerns headline but price ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.96% | 1M: +22.79%) — divergence (bullish price, bearish news) — watch for distribution. AIG (-50): CEO step-down headline; AIG in CORRECTION (1W: -10.52% | 1M: +0.58%) — news and price weakness confirm near-term risk.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION: Value/Cyclical style.  
Materials and Energy showing strength — FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.96% | 1M: +22.79%), SLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.91% | 1M: +10.17%).  
Key risk: MAJOR divergence across several large names (MSFT, CAT, AIG) and mixed news vs price (e.g., FCX positive price vs negative headlines) — watch for trend confirmation.
